Step 4: We can also use the fact that the product of all 13th roots of unity is 1. This means that $\prod_{k=0}^{12} \omega^k = 1$.

\[\prod_{k=0}^{12}(2-2\omega^k+\omega^{2k}) = \prod_{k=0}^{12}(2(1-\omega^k)+\omega^{2k}) = \prod_{k=0}^{12}(2-\omega^k)(1+\omega^k)\]

\[\prod_{k=0}^{12}(2-2\omega^k+\omega^{2k}) = \prod_{k=0}^{12}(2-\omega^k)(1+\omega^k) = \prod_{k=0}^{12}(2-\omega^k)\]
